propositions: test_full_backend_account_is_present fails deterministically on hosts with scc or lizard installed because it asserts a metric coverage record without controlling optional metric-tool availability
the 50-LOC test fixture is below the 800-LOC metric threshold, so when scc/lizard is resolved from PATH, _metric_invoke returns no match and emits no metric evidence record
the test incorrectly assumes the metric backend is always present in coverage reconstruction output, whereas it should be explicitly skipped with reason=no_tool when tools are absent

the sibling test test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already uses explicit missing-metric-tool fixture control to achieve host-independent determinism, but test_full_backend_account_is_present was missed during refactoring
the fix applies the same _METRIC_CANDIDATES fixture control to test_full_backend_account_is_present without changing production grounding semantics or evidence schema
